intended_object: The natural isomorphism A ≅ K(Spec A) between a bounded distributive lattice and the lattice of compact opens of its prime spectrum, which is the lattice-side unit of Stone duality between bounded distributive lattices and spectral spaces (Fujiwara–Kato, Thm 2.2.8). It is stated as an isomorphism 𝟭 ≅ Spec ⋙ K of functors on BddDistLatᵒᵖ. This is read off the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The component at A is the bounded-lattice isomorphism coming from `compactOpenOrderIso`. That map sends a to the basic open D(a) = {P prime ideal | a ∉ P}, which is the standard identification. The definition inverts this isomorphism and moves it to the opposite category with `.op`. Naturality is checked through `compactOpenOrderIso_symm_naturality`, which uses the fact that pulling back D(a) along the comap of f gives D(f a). The functors involved are the standard ones: the prime-ideal spectrum, sending a lattice map to the spectral map given by preimage of ideals, and the compact-opens functor, sending a spectral map to pullback. The category is the standard one: spectral spaces with spectral maps, and bounded distributive lattices. Defining it on all of BddDistLat is the natural generality. Mathlib has no Stone duality between distributive lattices and spectral spaces, so there is no counterpart.
